races.paceDynamic: With every single runner carrying a hold-up style rating, this is a classic case of no early pace that will create a muddling gallop through the early stages. Man Of The Sea, The Craftymaster and Everest may find themselves pushed into unwanted prominence simply by default, but none are natural front-runners who will stretch the field. The lack of genuine pace-setters means the field will bunch up and drift into the home straight before exploding into a sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs. This race shape heavily favours the strongest finishers who can produce the most explosive late kick from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is pedestrian as expected with reluctant leaders
scenarios.body: The field will bunch up turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish where the horse with the strongest turn of foot prevails. This heavily favours the most progressive hold-up performers with proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Man Of The Sea or Everest take the field along at a more honest tempo
scenarios.body: A steadier rhythm will create more separation and allow patient riders to time their challenges better. The slightly stronger pace will still favour hold-up horses but with less emphasis on pure finishing speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If no horse is willing to make the running in the early stages
scenarios.body: An extremely slow crawl will result in a mad dash from the 3f pole where positioning becomes crucial. Horses drawn handily with the most tactical speed will have significant advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: False Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If an early leader sets unsustainable fractions before fading
scenarios.body: Any horse that goes too fast early will pay the price, leaving the most patient hold-up horses to inherit the race. This extreme scenario massively favours those held up longest with the freshest finishes.

races.paceDynamic: Son Of Astar will take the early lead with minimal pressure from Darkened Edge, setting a steady but not punishing pace in the soft conditions. The bulk of the field - including Harry Mole, Legendsoftheland, Dark Sun, and Phoenix Beach - will sit behind waiting for their chance in the final two furlongs. This creates a perfect setup for the hold-up horses to deliver their finishing kicks. The lack of early pace pressure heavily favours late runners who can quicken from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Astar sets a moderate pace with no sustained pressure
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade pay dividends as they sweep past a tiring leader in the final furlong. Horses with good finishing kicks exploit the soft ground and tactical tempo perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Astar gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the leaders to get first run on the field and stay ahead of the late charge. Darkened Edge provides the main early threat to Son Of Astar's supremacy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in mid-division get the perfect trip as both leaders tire and hold-up horses are caught too far back. The race becomes a dash where tactical positioning trumps pure finishing speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Astar goes too slowly and creates a messy finish with multiple challenges
scenarios.body: The race turns into a scramble where any horse can win depending on racing room and split-second decisions. Form goes out the window in favor of whoever gets the clearest run.

races.paceDynamic: Secret Harvest and Doodling will establish the early pace, with Secret Harvest likely to take them along as the confirmed front runner. The relatively modest pace pressure means they can maintain a sustainable rhythm through the early stages without being burned off. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses (Lavender Bloom, Velvet Goldmine, I Can Dream, Miss Gold, Whazzimo) and several unproven runners, the pace-setters will have breathing space to dictate terms. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with early pace, as the hold-up brigade will struggle to make up ground on the good to soft surface.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Secret Harvest and Doodling maintain sustainable fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders get first run on the field and the hold-up horses struggle to close on the testing ground. Early pace proves decisive with the front pair having too much in hand.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainable and the leaders weaken in the final furlong
scenarios.body: Clementines Star and other lightly-raced runners with stamina reserves come through late. The early pace collapses allowing fresh legs to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely slow and kickback becomes crucial
scenarios.body: Velvet Goldmine and other proven hold-up performers get the perfect setup to unleash late runs. The soft ground aids their closing sectionals despite the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the form horses disappoint and class levels prove misleading
scenarios.body: Dark Angel Light or Honky Tonk Girl show previously unseen ability on their favoured surface. Inexperience becomes an advantage with no preconceived limitations.

races.paceDynamic: Ship To Shore and Basilette will set an honest but manageable pace from the front with their prominent styles, particularly on this testing ground at Bath's extended trip. Virtual Hug may also sit close early, but the pace won't be overly strong given the small number of natural leaders and the soft going conditions. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Master Dancer, Ottoman, Blue Hero, Belle Amie and others will be looking to produce late runs, but the combination of steady pace and testing conditions means they'll need to be closer than usual to strike. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can avoid getting too far back in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and the hold-up horses struggle to close on testing ground
scenarios.body: Ship To Shore and Basilette can control from the front while Virtual Hug tracks them perfectly positioned. The soft conditions make it difficult for the back markers to produce their usual finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and the ground plays fairer than expected
scenarios.body: Master Dancer and Ottoman can use their class to produce strong late runs from their hold-up positions. Belle Amie's recent form suggests she could also benefit from a patient ride.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improving Handicappers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the well-handicapped middle-distance types find the trip and conditions ideal
scenarios.body: Endofastorm and Highland Harvey can capitalize on their lower weights and recent decent form. Both have shown ability over similar trips and the slower pace could suit their style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and an unfancied hold-up horse finds dramatic improvement
scenarios.body: My O My or Blue Hero could spring a surprise from their hold-up positions with patient rides. The soft ground and extended trip might unlock untapped stamina reserves.

races.paceDynamic: India Gold will lead this from the start with no obvious challenger for the front-running role, setting what should be an even gallop without early pressure. Bosom Pals, Aneirin's Sword and Thisonesforyou will track prominently in the next group, while the majority of this field are hold-up horses who will need the pace to develop. With so many back-runners and limited early pace, this race sets up perfectly for horses that can position prominently or lead, as they'll have first run on a potentially bunched field turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If India Gold gets an easy lead and isn't pressured early.
scenarios.body: The front-runner will have every chance to dictate terms and kick clear when the pace lifts, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from deep positions. This scenario heavily favours the early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get ideal tactical positions behind India Gold.
scenarios.body: Bosom Pals or Aneirin's Sword can track the leader perfectly and have enough in reserve to challenge when the pace quickens. The hold-up horses still face the same traffic problems from the back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely and creates a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge where the best turn of foot wins, allowing one of the better-rated hold-up horses to sweep through. Even then, those positioned closer will have tactical advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Special
scenarios.trigger: If the race falls apart tactically with stop-start fractions.
scenarios.body: Chaos benefits horses with good recent form regardless of rating, particularly those stepping up from shorter distances. The form horses get outpaced by improvers or returning runners.

watchPoints.text: India Gold could get too easy a lead if no one goes with the pace early, making the front-runner very hard to peg back.

races.paceDynamic: Dappled Light is the only confirmed pace-setter in this 11-runner field, meaning she can dictate terms without early pressure over this Bath mile. With 10 hold-up horses behind her, she'll be allowed to bowl along at a comfortable rhythm through the early stages. The lack of pace competition creates a tactical race where the front-runner gets first run, but the soft ground and 1m trip mean stamina becomes crucial in the final 2f. This race shape strongly favours proven hold-up horses with finishing kicks, as they can track the lone leader and outstay her when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swarm
scenarios.trigger: If the field allows Dappled Light easy fractions and saves ground behind her.
scenarios.body: The pace quickens from 3f out as multiple closers fan wide, with the best stayers prevailing in a driving finish. King Of Speed and Thapa Vc benefit from their patient tactics and proven ability at this trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Dappled Light builds an unassailable lead through slow early fractions.
scenarios.body: She kicks clear turning for home before the field can organize a response, holding on grimly in the testing ground. Her recent Bath win confirms she handles these conditions well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and becomes a tactical crawl until the 2f pole.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where horses with natural speed rather than stamina dominate. Drafted's recent course form and Fighting Queen's tactical speed become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the large field bunches up behind the lone leader causing interference.
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get blocked or forced wide, allowing a horse with a clear run to capitalize. Eye Of The Water's veteran experience in navigating trouble becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Dappled Light could steal this if allowed easy early fractions as the only pace-setter in an 11-runner field

With nine hold-up horses including Nammos, Galactic Glow, King David, Revich, and Danehill Star all looking to come from behind, the pace should be steady rather than fierce early. This sets up a tactical battle where the front-runner could steal a march if allowed an easy lead, but also creates opportunities for strong finishers to sweep up late. scenarios.title: Brinton Controls Tempo

scenarios.body: Several of the fancied runners get stopped in their run and the race falls to those who get clear sailing. Brinton avoids trouble out front while one or two hold-up horses find daylight.
